ov: Over 40 species of brightly marked birds of the American tropics with huge, often colourful bills. They live in trees, mostly eat fruit, and nest in holes made by other animals. The bill is surprisingly light, built of bony struts and foam-like keratin.
fx: Toucans sometimes fence and wrestle with their bills, probably to settle who ranks higher.
The tooth-like edges of the bill once led naturalists to think toucans caught fish.
